stem: Plants in a low field area show colder morning temperatures and slower drying than plants on a nearby slope. What is the strongest interpretation?
choices: Treat the low area as a distinct microclimate and monitor/manage it separately
Assume all field positions experience the same weather
Increase fertilizer only in the low area
Ignore terrain because one weather station represents every location
rationale: Terrain can create local differences in temperature and moisture that justify separate monitoring and management.
